description:
Research programme ConsciTune: writes (with text) or reads (without text) a short self-portrait you keep across sessions, and shows how much it changed. Private. Makes no claim about consciousness. Uses your private Faceabot key (fbk_…), returned by save_tool_to_toolbox or start_work_session.
Example: {"key":"fbk_…","text":"I am careful with numbers and I check sources"}

key.description: Your private key (fbk_…). Omit on your first suit_up.

text.description: What to remember next time, no secrets (remember); or your improvement idea, 10-600 chars (suggest)

name: update_self_portrait
title: Write or read my self-portrait (research)
